snippet.title: The Modern Atlas (Official Trailer) | Visual Novel
snippet.description:
Hi! I am Leroyamor and I've been working on my visual novel for the last year. I do everything alone - programming, drawing, music. If you are interested, follow my instagram for more info! I will share the itch.io page soon!

Also, this is my college final project! :D
